items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel with the Legends was 'Montudie' Garland on bass, Louis Nelson on trombone, Joe Darensbourg on clarinet, myself on trumpet, Barry Martyn on drums, and Alton Purnell on piano.

ctx.x: Let's talk about your experiences with the Legends Of Jazz, after your rehearsing here in Los Angeles at Local 47 and your initial engagements with this group, and they were indeed legends. Mention to us once more first of all the personnel in that band.
The personnel with the Legends was 'Montudie' Garland on bass, Louis Nelson on trombone, Joe Darensbourg on clarinet, myself on trumpet, Barry Martyn on drums, and Alton Purnell on piano.
Is that group still pretty much in tact with the same kind of personnel?
